assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original pixel-art sprite animation sheet for an existing side-view browser action platformer.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity, costume and pixel-art style reference for the three existing enemies; Image 2 is a supporting reference for their body proportions and texture. Do not recreate these sheets: create a new attack-animation sheet.
Primary request: exactly 24 separate complete-body poses in a spacious 4-column by 6-row grid, read left-to-right row-by-row. Every character faces RIGHT, side view, feet consistently registered per row. All silhouettes fully inside their cells, generous empty separation, no labels, no UI, no shadows under feet, no detached particles. Background perfectly solid magenta #ff00ff for the game's established chroma-key import.
Rows 1-2: SAME gaunt soaked man in petrol-green torn municipal coat, amber eyes, boots, dark trousers as reference. Eight sequential poses of ONE readable forward claw strike: row 1 progresses through (1) slight alert shoulder lift (2) turn torso with elbow drawing back (3) knees braced, claw hand high behind shoulder (4) strongest anticipatory coil. Row 2: (5) forward open-hand thrust at chest height (6) fully extended forward downward follow-through (7) bent over, elbow returns (8) nearly neutral exhausted stance. The attack only reaches in front, never swings backwards.
Rows 3-4: SAME violet-hooded spitter, grey face, amber eye, long ragged raincoat. Row 3 four consecutive full-body anticipation poses: straighten slightly, hand rises toward throat, shoulders swell and mouth opens, lean back ready to spit. Row 4: two forward spitting body poses WITHOUT drawn projectile or spray; then two recoil-to-neutral recovery poses.
Rows 5-6: SAME black asphalt-matted hound, warm amber eyes, coarse wet fur. Row 5 four poses progressively coiling toward a pounce: ears pin back, shoulders lower, knees fold deeper, fully compressed crouch. Row 6: two forward leaping bite poses (gathered limbs then extended limbs), landing/compressed forelegs, then rising into alert stance.
Style: crisp authored 16-bit pixel clusters and controlled highlights, no smooth painting or anti-aliased linework. Preserve reference clothes, faces, anatomy, palette and realistic grim proportions. Strengthen the full-body silhouette and shoulder/hip/weight shifts so preparation reads at about 40px character height. Consistent scale across each creature's eight poses; crouching poses must not be enlarged to fill cells. No extra creatures, limbs, props, weapons, text, borders, blur, glow or perspective rotation. Wide enough gutters for every extended arm and tail.
